items.name: ast-calculus
items.description: This is a symbolic calculus machine (Integrator and Differentiator) with tokenizing and parsing supported for LaTeX-like equation format.

items.name: formula-to-latex
items.description: Конвертер математичних формул із текстової нотації у LaTeX та MathML (ядро Lexer→Parser→Generator + Flask REST API + Tkinter GUI)

items.name: latex_lexer
items.description: This project is a TypeScript-based lexer that converts Markdown input into LaTeX output. The lexer tokenizes the Markdown text, parses it into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), and then generates the corresponding LaTeX code.

items.name: TextConverter
items.description: A multi-format document converter (PDF, HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, JSON) based on a "parser > AST > renderer" architecture, featuring optional AI image processing and heuristic code detection.

items.name: LaTeX-to-HTML-Compiler
items.description: A source-to-source compiler developed using Lex (Flex), Yacc (Bison), and C that converts LaTeX documents into HTML. The project implements lexical analysis, syntax parsing, abstract syntax tree (AST) generation, and HTML code generation to demonstrate the principles of compiler design.

items.name: Keystroke2
items.description: A multi-format document converter written in Go with a web frontend. Supports six conversion paths between Markdown, HTML, and LaTeX — full lexer → parser → AST → renderer pipeline.

items.name: HTML-to-Latex-Converter
items.description: HTML to Latex converter can be directly used to make pdfs from input html files. It does so by doing lexical analysis of html followed by parsing and building of an Abstract Syntax Tree. The tree is maped to an euivalent AST of latex whose preorder traversal gives you the "texmaker" compilable code.
